headline: A 2007 executive order changed which Homeland Security officials would step in to lead the department if top leaders could not serve.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order changed the official order of succession in the Department of Homeland Security. That list decides who acts as head of the department if the Secretary and other top officials die, resign, or cannot do the job. No summary was provided, so the specific changes are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Senior officials at the Department of Homeland Security
who_it_affects.how: Their place in line to temporarily lead the department may have been changed.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed August 13, 2007; the exact effective date is not stated in the provided material.
